subject: Re: Exportability of telemetry & cookie mapping for DPA evidence
messages:
From: Anna Rossi <anna.rossi@evermarket.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Morales <jake.morales@evermarket.io>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Exportability of telemetry & cookie mapping for DPA evidence

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the console UX. We're kicking off our DPA evidence pack for an EU customer audit and have a couple of specific asks about telemetry and client-side tracking:

1) Export format: can Redwood produce a CSV/JSON export of raw telemetry events for a given date range (request id, timestamp, model_id, route, sampling flags, and an anonymized client identifier)? We need to hand that export to our auditors.

2) Cookie mapping: we need a simple mapping of cookie names + purpose (e.g., _rd_sid = session identifier; _rd_pref = preferences) and whether those cookies are first or third party. We saw references in docs but auditors want a canonical file.

3) Subprocessors & transfers: please confirm which subprocessors touch telemetry for hosted customers (analytics, monitoring, S3 backups, logging providers) and whether any telemetry mirrors to non-EEA regions by default. If there are region-based fallbacks, we need the fallback routes documented.

4) Console controls: is there a tenant-level toggle to disable client-side telemetry collection and an export of retention policy applied to that tenant? If not, what's the recommended mitigation we can show the auditors?

We'd like to get a short package by Friday (sample export, cookie map csv, current subprocessor list and a one-paragraph explanation of console controls). Happy to take a short screen share if that helps.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Rossi
Security & Privacy Lead, EverMarket
anna.rossi@evermarket.io

Attachments: none
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Rossi <anna.rossi@evermarket.io>, Jake Morales <jake.morales@evermarket.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Exportability of telemetry & cookie mapping for DPA evidence

Hi Anna — appreciate the clear asks. Looping in Laura (Legal) for subprocessors/transfer language and Mina (Product Infra) for exports and console controls. Quick answers inline, full package attached asap: 

1) Export format: yes — we can produce a per-tenant telemetry export in newline-delimited JSON or CSV. The exported fields we usually include: request_id, event_timestamp (ISO8601), tenant_id (hashed/anonymized on request), model_id, route, token_count, inference_latency_ms, sampling_flag, http_status. I attached a small sample CSV (export_sample_telemetry_schema.csv).

2) Cookie mapping: attached a one-page cookie map (CSV) with name, purpose, first_vs_third, retention. We'll confirm the final canonical names for any console beta flags you might be using.

3) Subprocessors & transfers: Laura — can you confirm the current approved subprocessors for telemetry (we believe: CloudLogs LLC for aggregated logs, S3 vendor for cold storage, MetricsCorp for internal dashboards) and note if any transfers to non-EEA regions happen for hosted tenants without region pinning?

4) Console controls: Mina — do we have an admin toggle to disable client-side telemetry collection per tenant? If not, what is the recommended mitigation (e.g., opt-out header + shortened retention + suppression of personal identifiers)? Also please attach the retention policy that would apply.

Anna, I'll get the attachments and a concise cover note suitable for auditors by Thursday EOD. If you need it in a specific layout for your audit checklist, send the template and we'll adapt.

Best,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Exportability of telemetry & cookie mapping for DPA evidence

Hi all — keeping this tight for the auditors. Summary of subprocessors and data transfer posture: 

- Subprocessors that may process telemetry: CloudLogs LLC (aggregated logging — US), MetricsCorp (dashboarding — EU-hosted by default, US fallback for burst), ObjectStore Partners (S3-compatible storage — multi-region depending on customer config).
- Cross-border: For hosted customers who have not selected a regional pin, MetricsCorp may receive aggregated metrics routed via our global bus which may transit/non-EEA endpoints for processing; raw telemetry storage is region-aware and we can configure EU-only storage for tenants with a contract clause.
- Legal note: under our DPA we offer SCCs and, where required, can accommodate EU-only retention/archive by contract. For the auditors, I'm attaching the up-to-date subprocessor registry (subprocessor-list-2026-11.pdf) and a short statement you can paste into evidence: "Redwood Inference routes telemetry according to customer region settings; subprocessors with potential non-EEA processing are listed in the attached registry; EU-only retention and storage can be configured by contractual controls and re-routing."

Connor/Mina: confirm console admin toggle situation to call out in the final note.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: subprocessor-list-2026-11.pdf
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Rossi <anna.rossi@evermarket.io>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Exportability of telemetry & cookie mapping for DPA evidence

Hi Anna — quick technical confirmation and attached artifacts.

- Tenant toggle: we do not yet have a single-click "disable all client-side telemetry" toggle in the hosted console GA. For customers on Dedicated/Private we offer configuration knobs. For hosted tenants we support: (a) a tenant-level opt-out header that suppresses client event collection when set; (b) a per-tenant retention override (e.g., 7/30/90/365 days) and (c) an anonymization option that hashes client identifiers before storage.

- Export capability: we can export raw telemetry (ndjson or CSV) for any date range. The tenant_id in the export will be hashed unless you request raw tenant identifiers in a special evidence export (requires an executed DPA addendum). Sample CSV attached (export_sample_telemetry_schema.csv).

- Cookie map: attached is a small CSV mapping current known cookie names and their purpose. We marked which are first-party vs third-party and the default retention.

Next steps for the audit package: 1) Connor will send a one-page cover note for auditors, 2) Laura's legal blurb included as evidence text, 3) we provide the CSV/ndjson export on request (ticket required) and will indicate whether the tenant uses EU-only storage.

If you'd like I can schedule a 25-min call to walk the auditor through the export schema and anonymization options.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Senior Product Engineer, Observability
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: export_sample_telemetry_schema.csv; cookie_map_evermarket.csv
